headline: Law lets older students at state maritime academies qualify for a federal student payment program tied to post-graduation service.
what_it_does: The Student Incentive Payment Program gives money to cadets at six state maritime academies who agree to a service obligation after they graduate. Before this law, cadets older than 25 could not join the program. The law changes the age rule so a cadet qualifies if they will meet the Navy Reserve's age limits for enlistment or commission when they graduate.

who_it_affects.group: Cadets over 25 at state maritime academies
who_it_affects.how: They can now qualify for the payments if they will meet Navy Reserve age requirements by graduation.
More of their students may become eligible for federal incentive payments.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted June 30, 2023; the summary does not state a separate effective date.
